title: Nerd's Chestnut Grove
description: The mod that adds my favorite tree, the chestnut!
body:
This mod adds my favorate tree to minecraft! The chestnut!

The main feature of this mod is the chestnut grove a new biome that has chestnut trees! Chestnut leaves also drop a new food item, chestniuts. You can roast chestnuts the chestnuts and eat them!
